from parcels import load_parcels, ROWS
from ranges import grams_between


def test_three_positions():
    data = list(load_parcels())
    assert grams_between(data, 2, 4) == [v for _, v in ROWS[1:4]]


def test_low_above_high():
    data = list(load_parcels())
    assert grams_between(data, 3, 2) == []
